summary: Verified the agentic visual edits on Wayly web app: (1) PageIntro sect-teal/sect-clay/sect-sage blocks now render as a very subtle low-opacity wash in LIGHT mode (rgba ~0.08-0.10) with dark primary-k text (rgb(14,77,82)) — clearly legible. (2) In DARK mode the same .sect-* blocks fall back to a dark wash (rgb(14,48,51) + tinted gradient) and the scoped html.theme-dark rule flips descendant text to rgba(255,255,255,0.85) / #fff — also legible. (3) Family Wall composer (data-testid=wall-composer) uses .sect-teal so the previously bright teal panel is now the soft tint; the Photo/Voice note/Dictate/Share row is fully readable in both themes. (4) Feed post cards (wall-post-<id>) each render as a low-opacity tinted card with a 5px coloured left accent bar (teal/clay/sage/plum/red rotation). (5) All 7 post timestamps in the seeded feed match the DD/MM/YYYY H:MM AM/PM format exactly — zero occurrences of :ss seconds and zero lowercase am/pm.

verification_evidence.composer_light_bg: rgba(14, 77, 82, 0.08) with inset 5px 0 0 #0E4D52 accent (subtle soft teal — matches spec, no longer bright)
verification_evidence.composer_dark_bg: rgb(14, 48, 51) + linear-gradient(rgba(79,168,174,0.12)) with white child text
verification_evidence.pageintro_light_child_text_color: rgb(14, 77, 82)  (primary-k dark text on light wash — legible)
verification_evidence.timestamp_regex_check: All 7 match ^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{1,2}:\d{2} (AM|PM)$. Zero seconds, zero lowercase.

critical_code_review_comments: Composer button row uses text-primary-k on rgba(14,77,82,0.08) — legibility verified visually and via computed color (rgb(14,77,82)). Contrast is adequate but on the low side; consider a slightly darker text or a smaller composer wash if any accessibility audit flags it. Not blocking.
The dark-mode scoped selector at index.css:1579 uses :is(...) with a not([class*="bg-"]) filter — this correctly preserves nested pills (e.g. reaction chips with bg-* classes). Good.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded posts on cathy@example.com (family plan).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright DOM inspection + screenshots that .sect-teal/.sect-clay/.sect-sage are a subtle low-opacity wash in light mode (~8-10% alpha) with primary-k dark text, and in dark mode they get a dark wash + scoped white text via the html.theme-dark rule at /app/frontend/src/index.css:1579.
